blurb: Jeff Pu is a Hong Kong-based equity research analyst at Haitong International Securities, covering Apple and the broader consumer electronics supply chain. He is widely cited in tech media for his supply chain checks on Apple product cycles — iPhone builds, Mac shipments, and component orders. His notes and estimates are regularly picked up by outlets like 9to5Mac, MacRumors, and Bloomberg as early indicators of Apple production trends.
credibility_note: Pu's Apple supply chain estimates have a mixed track record — accurate on broad directional trends but sometimes off on precise unit numbers. He is a sell-side analyst, so his coverage carries the standard caveats around investment banking relationships and house bias.
